decisive_items: a solid portion that enhanced in the early phase and washed out in the delayed phase
CTAP showed absence of the right portal vein and a perfusion defect throughout the right lobe, suggestive of portal vein tumor thrombus
A 55-year-old man underwent right hemicolectomy for moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma of the ascending colon
response.rationale: The imaging features (early enhancement with washout) and portal vein tumor thrombus are classic for hepatocellular carcinoma, despite the history of colon cancer. The colon cancer history supports metastasis, but the specific vascular pattern and portal vein invasion favor HCC.

rejected.why: Colon cancer history and liver lesion are supportive, but the imaging pattern (early washout) and portal vein thrombus are more specific for HCC, and tumor markers are normal, making metastasis less typical.
